form.title: Create action drafts
form.intro: Paste the conversation as it is. FlowDesk separates actions and sends ambiguity to review.
form.defaultGoal: Default: extract follow-up actions from conversation
form.contextPlaceholder: For example: identify work that needs follow-up and clarify owners, dates and next steps.
form.messagePlaceholder: Paste the raw chat. It can include multiple messages, numbering, and incomplete verbal agreements.
form.hint: No cleanup required. FlowDesk separates actions, saves the source, and flags missing owners or dates.
form.replace: Generating again replaces the current draft batch. Saved actions stay in the list.
